args.body:
- Newsletter (Bellwether Office, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): points readers to the main article on cold-chain trends and a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
- Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain): temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion): pilots of live sensor-data sharing cut claims by roughly a quarter.
args.title: Bellwether Office: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — newsletter, article & companion
